vehicles.name: PV - Person- og varebil

source.title: Grundlag for udformning af trafikarealer
source.figure: Type vehicle diagram, PDF page 38; steering table Figure 6.7
source.notes: Body width excludes mirrors. Mode A uses 33 gon, represented as 29.7 degrees. Axle track and tyre width are measured from the official PV DWG vehicle block; they reproduce rear-inner and front-outer wheel-edge offsets of 0.704 m and 0.875 m.

vehicles.validationNotes: Dimensions are source-transcribed and reference-validated. The 2026-09-02 official-DWG certification run passed 6 of 6 required cases, with a worst envelope deviation of 0.052 m against a 0.10 m tolerance; see reference/certification/reference-certification.json.

vehicles.name: REN - Renovationskøretøj

source.title: Grundlag for udformning af trafikarealer
source.figure: Type vehicle diagram, PDF page 41; steering table Figure 6.7
source.notes: The first rear axle shown by the official dimension chain is used as the effective rear-axle reference. Axle track and tyre width are measured from the official REN DWG vehicle block; they reproduce rear-inner and front-outer wheel-edge offsets of 0.996 m and 1.250 m.

vehicles.validationNotes: Dimensions are source-transcribed. The 2026-09-01 official-DWG certification run passed 0 of 6 required cases; rear-track extraction also remains ambiguous for some cases.

vehicles.name: BUS 12 - 12 m bus

source.title: Grundlag for udformning af trafikarealer
source.figure: Type vehicle diagram, PDF page 38; steering table Figure 6.7
source.notes: Body width excludes mirrors. Two-axle 12 m type-vehicle geometry. Axle track and tyre width are measured from the official BUS 12 DWG vehicle block; they reproduce rear-inner and front-outer wheel-edge offsets of 0.971 m and 1.225 m.

vehicles.validationNotes: Dimensions are source-transcribed. The 2026-09-01 official-DWG certification run passed 0 of 6 required cases; wheel-trace extraction also remains ambiguous for some cases.
